note: No state-level general contractor license -- licensing is purely local (county/city/town). §16-6-1101 (Title 16 Ch.6 Art.11, confirmed via wyoleg.gov's official statute text) is NOT a state license or a public-works-bidding requirement; it's a horizontal reciprocity mandate forcing local licensing jurisdictions to recognize each other's licenses. Electrical is the only state-licensed trade in WY (2026-07-08, hand-verified).
